db:insert.doc:name: Store Order Details
db:insert.db:sql: insert into ORDERS (order_id, phone_number, sku, quantity, order_channel, payment_mode, delivery_preference) values (:order_id , :phone_number , :sku , :quantity , :order_channel, :payment_mode , :delivery_preference);
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ order_id: payload.orderId, phone_number: payload.phoneNumber, sku: payload.sku, quantity: payload.quantity, status: payload.status, failure_reason: payload.failureReason, order_channel: payload.orderChannel, payment_mode: payload.paymentMode, delivery_preference: payload.deliveryPreference }]

db:update.doc:name: Update Inventory
db:update.db:sql: update INVENTORY set quantity_available = quantity_available - :updated_quantity where sku = :sku and quantity_available >= :updated_quantity;
